action: WAGO advises (per CERT@VDE) updating to firmware 4.10.0 (FW32) or higher; for custom firmware, contact WAGO support.
date_note: The CERT@VDE advisory page gives 23 November as its publication day and no earlier date.
exec: CERT@VDE lists two flaws in WAGO controller firmware earlier than 4.10.0 (FW32); one may allow command execution with root privileges.
plain: CERT@VDE says WAGO controllers and panels running firmware earlier than 4.10.0 (FW32) have two flaws, one of which may let a low-privileged attacker run commands as root. WAGO's fix is firmware 4.10.0 (FW32) or higher.

key_findings: Covers CVE-2026-80466 (OS command injection in web-based management routing configuration) and CVE-2026-88850 (missing authorization in PROFIBUS configuration).
Affected: wago_os_linux earlier than 4.10.0 (FW32) and custom wago_os_linux earlier than 4.10.0 (70).
recommendations: Update to firmware 4.10.0 (FW32) or higher; for custom firmware contact WAGO support.

sources.name: CERT@VDE VDE-2026-096: WAGO Improper Authorization and Privilege Escalation

summary: CERT@VDE advisory VDE-2026-096 lists two flaws in WAGO wago_os_linux earlier than 4.10.0 (FW32). CVE-2026-80466, an OS command injection in web-based management, may allow a low-privileged attacker to execute commands with root privileges; CVE-2026-88850 is missing authorization in PROFIBUS configuration. The fix is firmware 4.10.0 (FW32) or higher.
title: CERT@VDE: WAGO controller firmware flaws allow command injection and missing authorization

validation.note: Primary source: CERT@VDE advisory VDE-2026-096, read in full. No second publisher read.
